senses.gloss:
इङ्ग् इङ्ग् (probably a denomin. derived from इङ्ग), i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Bhag. 14, 23), To move, MBh. 3, 8756.
 इङ्गित, n. Gesture, Man. 7, 67.

इङ्ग इङ्ग, i. e. इञ्ज् (cf. Bṛh. Ār. Up. 6, 4, 23, akin to एज् and विज्) + अ, adj., f. गा, Moveable, MBh. 3, 8756.
 --Comp.

इङ्गुद इङ्गुद,
 I. m. and दी f. The name of a plant, Terminalia catappa.
 II. n. Its nut.
